patterns.note: The hero section employs an asymmetrical layout, featuring a prominent, large-scale text block on the left balanced by a dynamic, multi-layered visual element on the right.
A sophisticated pairing of an elegant, large-scale serif typeface for headings with a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and UI elements creates a blend of classic and contemporary aesthetics.

The site uses a refined palette of warm, muted neutrals (light beige, dark charcoal) as primary and secondary colors, strikingly accented by a vibrant, almost neon, lime green for calls to action and highlights.
Sections and content elements are revealed with a subtle, staggered fade-in or slide-up animation as the user scrolls down the page, creating a guided and engaging content discovery experience.
The footer is uniquely presented as a distinct, semi-transparent card with rounded corners, appearing to float above a blurred background image that is revealed upon reaching the bottom of the page.

technique_notes: The hero section integrates a video or animated sequence, likely using `video-hero` and `gsap`, where a central figure is dynamically framed by page-like elements that animate around her.
Content sections are introduced using scroll-triggered animations, employing `gsap` or `css-keyframes` to achieve a staggered fade-up or slide-in effect as elements enter the viewport.

The footer is implemented as a distinct UI component with a backdrop blur effect, giving it a frosted glass appearance, and is positioned to overlay a fixed or parallaxing background image as the user scrolls to the page's end.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) with generous line height, complemented by a clean, readable sans-serif for body text and smaller UI elements.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (small radius) on buttons and the footer card, providing a soft, modern touch.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and airy, particularly in the hero section, with clear vertical separation between content blocks and ample padding around elements.

standout: This site stands out with its sophisticated blend of classic serif typography and a modern, vibrant lime green accent. The unique footer design, presented as a floating, semi-transparent card over a blurred background, is particularly distinctive, as is the dynamic, multi-layered video hero that frames the central figure with animated page elements.
